newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.38 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Friday, August 1, was fixed at 20.3800 percent, or a rise of 29.50 basis points from 20.0850 percent, the rate for July 31, Banco de Mexico said on Thursday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Friday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
